caption: Divide: 0.3 divided by the distance from the centre - rings that crowd toward the middle, a tunnel
why: a divided by b scales a value down by another (a size by a count, a distance by a speed), and one over a distance gives a value that rushes up near the middle - the perspective of a tunnel. Divide gives 0 rather than an error when b is 0, so it is safe on the centre pixel.
Its neighbours: Multiply scales up; Modulo gives the remainder; Divide makes ratios and perspective.
steps: **a** is 0.3. **b** is **Coords** `r`, the distance from the centre.
a over b is small at the edges and grows fast toward the middle.
Plus a clock (**Time** times 0.3, an **Add**) it is a **Wave**'s x (1 cycle): rings that are wide at the edge and crowd together toward the middle, moving - looking down a tunnel.
The wave is the **Palette**'s brightness; the same sum picks the colour.

try.label: Deeper
try.text: a 0.8: the rings crowd much more toward the centre - a deeper tunnel.

try.label: Shallow
try.text: a 0.1: the rings are wide nearly everywhere, crowding only at the very centre.
